title: Fast-rising star Eastside JP puts numbers on the board with his new record "Gallery Dept"
htmlContent:
A self-proclaimed music star, Eastside JP is a multi-talented singer and songwriter who uses his enticing voice to bring the big picture to the moment. He effortlessly blends with intricate rhyme patterns and colorful melodies to create a sonic universe that is truly his own. The talented star once again does not disappoint in the release of his recent track "Gallery Dept."

Eastside JP's "Gallery Dept" is part of the song that drops off his newest project this year. The vocal performance of this song is impressive, the songwriting is brilliant, and the production is beyond genius that truly makes this record beyond music, but just sheer art for the world to enjoy.
